name: Decimal-aligned numbers & units (siunitx)
description: Numbers aligned on the decimal point with the `S` column, plus consistent units in text.
notes: `table-format=2.3` means 2 integer digits and 3 decimals. It reserves the right width so the column is centred.
Wrap non-numeric header cells in braces `{...}` or siunitx tries to parse them as numbers.
